items.myth: The settlement guarantees retirees their full pension.
items.fact: It guarantees at least 75% of full benefits. The remaining 25% depended on separate Government funding.

items.myth: The Settlement Fund decided to stop the 25%.
items.fact: The Government informed the Fund there was no funding for the 25% payments beyond December 31, 2025.

items.myth: The Government’s yearly payment is voluntary.
items.fact: The settlement requires the NMI Government to make annual payments to the Settlement Fund.
